source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U23: Distinguish conversion,vesting and continuing reporting obligations

payload.title: Conversion transfers obligations as well as assets
payload.core_explanation_md:
The statute has separate conversion routes and schedules for an ordinary firm, a private company and an unlisted public company. The registration certificate date determines the described conversion effect. Assets, rights and liabilities vest under the applicable route, and the predecessor record is removed as provided. Do not describe conversion as a way to retain assets while abandoning the old debt.

Check the schedule eligibility, registration and required notice to the predecessor Registrar. Existing security, guarantees, contracts and registry entries need their own reconciliation rather than treating a new suffix as the whole transaction. The LLP also has accounting, solvency-statement and annual-return responsibilities. The source states the annual return within60 days of financial-year closure; audit applicability and filing forms require the relevant rules rather than the blanket claim that every LLP statement is always audited.

self_check.prompt_text: Does conversion allow liabilities to be left behind automatically?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The described vesting expressly includes obligations.

payload.stem_md: A converted LLP claims it received the predecessor assets but none of its liabilities merely because the old record was removed. What is wrong?

options.text_md: The old and new names must always be identical
options.explanation_md: That is not the relevant issue.

options.text_md: The applicable conversion vesting includes liabilities and obligations
options.explanation_md: Record removal does not erase the transferred debt.

options.text_md: A bank can ignore all conversion evidence

payload.correct_explanation_md: Record removal does not erase the transferred debt.

payload.stem_md: A listed public company invokes the same conversion route described for an unlisted public company without checking eligibility. What must be examined?

options.text_md: The exact statutory route and schedule eligibility
options.explanation_md: The categories cannot simply be interchanged.

options.text_md: Only the number of bank accounts
Whether a new logo was adopted

payload.correct_explanation_md: The categories cannot simply be interchanged.
